disease_state.evidence: Our study shows that DEP-1 is an insulin-regulated gene, dysregulated in obesity, and uncovers its role in brain insulin signaling, impacting both anabolic and catabolic pathways.

material_type.evidence: inferred: These opposing pathways in male DEP-1 forebrain-specific knockout mice resulted in elevated lipolysis in white adipose tissue and fat oxidation in brown adipose tissue, with enhanced sympathetic activation and β-adrenergic receptor expression.
